lead: Virtual Sundays run on Google Classroom and Google Meet.

students.title: Sign in with your school account
students.body: Use the ISSV Google account, not a personal or parent Gmail. Most problems come from the wrong account.

students.title: Open your class in Google Classroom
students.body: Go to classroom.google.com or the Classroom app. Your class is already there. If it shows Join, click it.

students.title: Join the Meet from Classroom
students.body: On your class’s Stream page, click Join next to Meet. It’s the same link every time.

students.title: Be ready by 10:00 AM
students.body: Join by 10:15 to test your camera and sound. Usual schedule, ending at 1:30 PM.

teachers.title: Use your ISSV account
teachers.body: The admin creates each class and adds you and your students.

teachers.title: Turn on the Meet link (once)
teachers.body: Class Settings (gear) → General → Meet link: generate it and make it visible to students. Use only this link.

teachers.title: Remind students Saturday
teachers.body: Post in the Stream: “Virtual class tomorrow at 10. Join from the Meet link here, with your school account.”

teachers.title: Open the Meet at 9:50
teachers.body: Start from Classroom and turn on Host controls (shield icon) to mute everyone and manage joining.

teachers.title: Admit carefully
teachers.body: Personal accounts show as “asking to join”. Admit names you know, and remind them to switch accounts.

teachers.title: Wrap up
teachers.body: Post homework in Classwork, take attendance from People, and choose “End the call for everyone”.

troubleshooting.q: Stuck on “Ask to join”, or can’t join
troubleshooting.a: You’re likely on a personal Gmail. Click your profile picture (top right), switch to your school account, and reopen the link from Classroom.
Check the signed-in account (profile picture, top right). If it’s the school account, email us.

troubleshooting.q: Our shared computer keeps using the parent’s account
troubleshooting.a: In Chrome, click the profile icon (top right) → Add, and make a profile for the student’s school account. Use it for every class.

troubleshooting.q: Joining from a phone or tablet
troubleshooting.a: Install the Classroom and Meet apps, add the school account in each (tap the profile picture), and select it.

troubleshooting.q: No sound, or nobody can hear me
troubleshooting.a: Check you’re unmuted, then ⋮ → Settings → Audio and pick the right microphone and speaker.
